LanguageData.HH.UI.Tab.GuideTip: Show or hide the little lesson panel at the top right.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.ThisSaveTip: Edit the settings of the running colony. They are saved with it.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.TemplateTip: Edit the template that new colonies start from. The running colony is not changed.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.TemplateOnly: Template for new games. Each new colony gets its own copy.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.EditingTemplate: Editing the template for new games. The running colony is not changed.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.SaveAsTemplateTip: Copies modules, difficulty and all settings of this colony into the template for new games.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.SaveAsTemplateConfirm: Replace the template for new games with the settings of this colony?
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.ApplyTemplateTip: Replaces the settings of this colony with the template.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.ApplyTemplateConfirm: Replace modules, difficulty and all settings of this colony with the template? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.NoMatch: No setting matches. Nerd settings are hidden unless you switch them on.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.NerdTip: Shows the settings meant for people who like numbers. Everything else is unchanged.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.ResetModuleConfirm: Reset every setting of {0} to its default?
LanguageData.HH.UI.Settings.ModuleIsOff: This module is switched off for this colony. Its settings have no effect.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Row.FreeTip: Free entry: type any number up to the technical limit of the game.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Row.Beyond: Beyond the slider range. Free entry allows this.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Row.LimitGeneric: The game cannot use this value, so the nearest possible one is used.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Row.FollowsTier: The default follows the hosting difficulty.
LanguageData.HH.UI.General.ShowCard: Show the first-start card in every new game
LanguageData.HH.UI.General.ShowCardTip: Off: new games quietly use the template and no card appears.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Modules.IntroSave: Modules can be switched per colony. A module that is off has no visible effect at all.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Modules.IntroTemplate: Modules for new colonies. Each colony can still change its own.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Modules.BankHint: Bank: use the bank inside Hearth & Harbor and switch all guest modules off. You do not need the standalone entry.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Modules.ContentDesc: How dark the optional content may get. Never sexual content, whatever you pick.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Content.Standard.Tip: The default. Rough edges, nothing nasty.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Content.Dark.Tip: Adds to Standard: prisoners may fight to the death, be questioned harder and be hunted (with a fitting ideology), and an organ clinic and the dark menu become possible.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Content.Grim.Tip: Adds to Dark: hunting prisoners needs no fitting ideology, and organ buyers place orders with deadlines.
LanguageData.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Inn: Guests, guest beds, wings, reception, travellers and recruiting.
LanguageData.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.ShopsFood: Venue signs, shops, vending, markets, restaurants and dishes.
LanguageData.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Casino: Tables, slot machines, chips and the risks of gambling for guests and colonists.
LanguageData.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.CityLife: Cinema, mall, salon, temples, taxis and security.
LanguageData.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Underworld: A discreet back room, a fight pit and a fence. Nothing of it happens until you build it.
LanguageData.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Bank: Silverline: accounts, payments, ATMs, investments, loans, insurance and lottery.
LanguageData.HH.UI.ModuleDesc.AiFlavour: Optional flavour texts written by an AI through a relay. Off by default.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diff.Title: Hosting difficulty
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diff.Calculator: What this tier means for you
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diff.ShowAll: Show all {0} values that follow the difficulty
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diff.WarnHard: From Overbooked on, underworld incidents can cost real goodwill, renown and silver (see the caps below).
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diff.WarnEasy: This tier is very forgiving. Money comes easy and nothing goes wrong.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diff.WarnBreaks: This breaks the game balance. On purpose?
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.SetByYou: You changed this value yourself, so it does not follow the slider.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.NoEffectInfinite: No effect while Infinite guest money is on.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Feel.1: Money flows and nothing goes wrong.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Feel.3: Small losses are possible. Profit takes work.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Feel.4: Underworld incidents start to cost goodwill, renown and fines.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Feel.5: Bigger penalties for underworld incidents, a harder bank.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Feel.6: Everything is hard and nothing is capped.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.guestMoney.Desc: Multiplies what guests carry and are willing to spend.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.priceTolerance.Desc: How far above a fair price guests still buy.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.expectation.Desc: Added to what every guest expects. Higher is harder to satisfy.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.bankM.Desc: Yearly multiplier of the Silverline market. 1.2 means plus twenty percent.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.collectionStage.Desc: How rough debt collection can get when you owe money.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.researchCost.Desc: Multiplies the cost of Hearth & Harbor and Silverline research.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.insuranceLoading.Desc: The insurer's markup on top of a fair premium.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.salesPressure.Desc: How pushy the insurer's sales tricks get.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.addiction.Desc: Base chance that a colonist who gambles a lot becomes addicted.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Ladder.Goodwill.Desc: The most goodwill one underworld incident can take away from you.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Ladder.Renown.Desc: The most renown one underworld incident can cost you.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Ladder.Fine.Desc: The most a single underworld incident can fine you.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Ladder.Footer: These caps apply to underworld incidents. The bank collection stages follow their own settings.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diag.PrepareRemovalTip: Gets the colony ready for taking the mod out: guests go home, open accounts are settled, special items are cleaned up.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diag.PrepareRemovalConfirm: Prepare this colony for removing Hearth & Harbor? Guests are sent home and accounts are settled. Save a backup first.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diag.RemovalDone: Done. Save the game, then remove the mod.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diag.NeedsSave: Open a colony first. Preparing removal works on a running game.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Diag.Summary: {0} settings registered · {1} warnings · {2} errors in the log
LanguageData.HH.UI.About.Body: Hearth & Harbor turns your colony into a host: guests, inns and hotels, shops and restaurants, a casino, a spa, city life, a discreet back room and Silverline, a full bank. Nothing is forced on you. Until you mark a guest bed or put up a sign, the game plays like vanilla.
LanguageData.HH.UI.About.PartsBody: Silverline bank included: {0}. Guest modules included: {1}.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Card.Title: Welcome to Hearth & Harbor
LanguageData.HH.UI.Card.Sub: Pick your hosting style. Everything can be changed later in the mod settings.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Card.SubJoined: Nothing changes until you build something for guests. Pick how you want to host.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Card.UseForAll: Use these choices for all future games
LanguageData.HH.UI.Card.UseForAllTip: Copies modules, difficulty and tutorial level into the template that new games start from.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Preset.JustWork.Desc: Standard difficulty, everything on. Start building, we explain on the way.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Preset.CozyInn.Desc: Gentler, with fewer ways to lose: no casino and no underworld.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Preset.Tycoon.Desc: Everything on with a short guide. Staff, bookings and the ledger are yours to run.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Preset.Nerd.Desc: Every slider, formulas and nerd settings. No guide.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Tutorial.FullFirstTime.Tip: Full guide in the first colony with this mod, short afterwards.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Tutorial.AlwaysFull.Tip: Topics open on first contact, every time.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Storyteller.Head: HOSTING DIFFICULTY · {0} %
LanguageData.HH.UI.Storyteller.Tip: How hard hosting guests gets in this colony. It is separate from the raid difficulty above.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Overview.IncomeTip: Silver paid into your tills since dawn.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Overview.VenuesTip: Rooms with a venue sign on the current map.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Overview.BankTip: Balance of the colony account at Silverline.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Overview.NoIncome: No income yet. It shows up here as soon as a guest pays.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Overview.Arrivals: Arrivals, next 24 h: {0}, about {1} groups a day expected.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Guests.Head: Guests · {0} here · {1} day guests
LanguageData.HH.UI.Guests.VanillaNote: The Inn module is off, so ordinary visitors are shown.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Guests.SatTip: How happy this guest is, from -1 to +1. Latest reasons:
LanguageData.HH.UI.Guests.Col.Name: Guest
LanguageData.HH.UI.Guests.HandlingTip: Click to switch the handling. Accompany, Recruit and Convert need colonists with Hosting work; Convert only shows for guests of another ideoligion (Ideology).
LanguageData.HH.UI.Venue.ClosedTip: Outside its opening hours. Change the hours on the venue sign.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Venue.NoStaffTip: Open, but nobody is on duty. Give a colonist Serving work (or let the venue run without staff on its sign).
LanguageData.HH.UI.Venue.NoStockTip: Nothing to sell in the room. Put goods, drinks or meals on a shelf or stockpile inside it.
LanguageData.HH.UI.GuestTab.Label: Guest
LanguageData.HH.UI.GuestTab.NoInfo: No guest record for this pawn.
LanguageData.HH.UI.GuestTab.SatisfactionTip: From -1 (furious) to +1 (delighted). It drives renown, goodwill and whether the guest comes back.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Handling.Basics.Tip: Paid services only, no entertainment. Costs no colonist time.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Handling.Accompany.Tip: Colonists on Hosting entertain this guest and show them around: mood +1 to +4 by social skill. Costs colonist time. Without a colonist on Hosting it stays Basics.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Handling.Recruit.Tip: Like Accompany, plus recruitment talks. A clumsy talk can offend: mood -6, 30 % less spending, leaves half a day early.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Handling.Convert.Tip: Like Accompany, plus talks about your ideoligion. Each talk shakes the guest's certainty in their own; at zero they take on yours. A pushy talk can offend (mood -4, less spending). Needs the Ideology DLC and a guest of another ideoligion.
LanguageData.HH.UI.DevGroup.Label: Dev: Hearth & Harbor
LanguageData.HH.UI.DevGroup.Desc: Dev-mode tools of Hearth & Harbor for this building ({0}). Only shown in dev mode; switch the grouping off in the Inn settings.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Guide.Title: Hearth & Harbor Guide
LanguageData.HH.UI.Guide.TitleTip: Right-click to hide. You can bring it back in the Hearth & Harbor tab or the settings.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Guide.Hidden: Guide hidden. Bring it back with the Guide button in the Hearth & Harbor tab or in the settings.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.windowScale.Desc: All Hearth & Harbor and Silverline windows grow or shrink by this factor (on top of the automatic size for large screens).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.researchCost.Desc: Multiplies the cost of Hearth & Harbor and Silverline research projects. Follows the hosting difficulty.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.neverDie.Desc: Guests are knocked down instead of killed. They keep living, downed, until someone tends them.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.infiniteMoney.Desc: Guests who arrive while this is on carry a bottomless purse. The guest money factor has no effect on them.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.picky.Desc: Guests expect a little more from every stay (expectation +0.1).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.ironBank.Desc: Debt collection always climbs to the highest stage, whatever the difficulty. Nobody quietly defers your instalments.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.noResearchGating.Desc: Everything on the Hearth & Harbor and Silverline trees is available from the start.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.peacefulUnderworld.Desc: Dark venues work without violence: no fight pit, no questioning, no hunting of people, no clinic, no protection racket. Back room, fence and drug lounge stay.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.showMath.Desc: Shows nerd settings and formulas everywhere.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.perfMode.Desc: Guest planning and room checks run half as often. Helps on slow computers; guests may react a little later.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Calc.slotRtp.Desc: Share of every bet a slot machine pays back on average. The house keeps the rest.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Page.Sub.overview: Today at a glance: guests, takings and every venue's state.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Page.Sub.guests: Everyone staying at or visiting your inn. Click a row to jump to the guest; click the handling cell to change it.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Page.Sub.casino: Houses, takings and how each game is doing against its odds.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Page.Sub.city: Cinema, salon, gallery, park, taxi and security: what is built and what it earns.
LanguageData.HH.UI.Page.Sub.underworld: Whispers, arrival weights and the takings of the dark side.
